channel.title: AI Threat Watch: threats on the wire
channel.description: Headlines the robot classified as incidents or exploited flaws, refreshed every 30 minutes.

item.title: GHSA-jm63-cq47-j5jp / CVE-2026-111770: MCP TypeScript server SDK: Shared transport or server instances delivered one HTTP client's messages to another (@modelcontextprotocol/server, high)
item.description: GitHub Advisory Database: MCP TypeScript server SDK could deliver one HTTP client's messages to another when transport or server instances were shared.

item.title: GHSA-46jr-4wx8-v453 / CVE-2026-111768: MCP TypeScript SDK: One HTTP request within the default size limit could exhaust server memory during validation (@modelcontextprotocol/sdk, @modelcontextprotoco
item.description: GitHub Advisory Database: MCP TypeScript SDK let a single HTTP request within the 4 MiB limit exhaust server memory during validation.

item.title: GHSA-rvq5-wwqv-78pq / CVE-2026-111771: MCP TypeScript SDK: Server bearer authentication accepted tokens issued for another service (@modelcontextprotocol/sdk, @modelcontextprotocol/server, @modelconte
item.description: GitHub Advisory Database: The MCP TypeScript SDK's server bearer authentication accepted tokens issued for another service, because it could not check the token audience (CVE-2026-111771).

item.title: Plus de 100 entreprises piratées par une armée d'agents IA contrôlée par un cybercriminel chinois

item.title: GHSA-22jm-h49p-29qw / CVE-2026-111767: MCP TypeScript SDK: Experimental tasks were not tied to the session that created them (@modelcontextprotocol/sdk, high)
item.description: GitHub Advisory Database: MCP TypeScript SDK experimental tasks were not tied to their creating session, so clients sharing a task store could read and cancel each other's tasks.

item.title: GHSA-6prh-2h8m-c8cw / CVE-2026-111769: MCP TypeScript client SDK: HTTP client transports and OAuth requests followed cross-origin redirects and re-sent custom headers and request bodies (@modelcontext
item.description: GitHub Advisory Database: MCP TypeScript client SDK followed cross-origin redirects and re-sent custom headers and request bodies, which could expose API keys.

item.title: GHSA-527g-ff96-x6wj / CVE-2026-113671: ApostropheCMS: Host header controls server-side image fetch origin in @apostrophecms/ai-helper, enabling authenticated SSRF (@apostrophecms/ai-helper, medium)
item.description: GitHub Advisory Database: ApostropheCMS ai-helper package lets the Host header control a server-side image fetch, enabling authenticated SSRF.
